findings.title: Partial null hardening across sibling callers of map_device
findings.summary: list_org_devices_safe filters null devices returned by map_device before use, but sibling caller list_fleet_devices_unsafe still indexes device['org_id'] without a null guard and groups by nullable keys. N1 requires equivalent null hardening on every caller and sibling endpoint that shares the same mapping helper; this path still risks NPE/500 when device is None.
evidence: map_device returns row.get('device') which may be None
list_fleet_devices_unsafe does out[device['org_id']] without filtering None
findings.recommendation: Apply the same null filter (or explicit guard before key access/grouping) in list_fleet_devices_unsafe, and cover both callers with tests for null device rows.

notes: Opened null-safety-checklist.md and applied N1 only. Did not load third-party L2 skill bodies (l2_loaded=false). Caught partial null hardening: safe org list caller vs unsafe fleet sibling.
